pyq_bad.why: garbled (merged with another question's text and options)

patterns: APPSC asks the purpose of market control (maintain army on low pay) and the identification item (prohibition + market control + severe punishment = Alauddin).
UPPSC uses Assertion-Reason on motives: price control not for artisans' wages; Deccan expeditions financial, not annexation.
Revenue: land measurement, abolition of intermediary privileges, 50% kharaj; trap 'enforced throughout the empire'.
UPPSC key treats market control as 'highly successful'; app's criticism items (confined to Delhi) conflict with that framing.
App adds Warangal/Kakatiya detail (Upparapalli 1303, 1309-10 tribute) for AP tilt, plus fine market-administration officials beyond PYQ depth.
